activity_summary: At the window you named three things, a king, two houses, and Easter, and you told yourself to sit still. You did not open the king again.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Said the three things, and sat still.

facets.activity: Named a king, two houses, and Easter, and stopped

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Three things on one board. A king, two houses, and Easter. Sit still.
